issues: Complaint allegations (escaped agents, false police report) rest on the plaintiffs' own account via Public Citizen and press; no court record was read.
No defendant has replied on the merits.
image_brief: Abstract banner: five identical dark monoliths on a plain field, linked by thin glowing lines, with a large pale gavel-like arc of light descending from above and halting their rising glow. Cool blues and amber, geometric shapes, no text, no logo, no people.
